title: Dot product and matrix-vector multiplication
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $H$ be an $m\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$, and take $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ and $y\in\mathbb F_2^m$. The dot product of $\gamma$ with the row-vector product $yH$ equals the dot product of $H\gamma$ with $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is an $m\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$
